review: 2:1–2:2 וַאֲנִי תְּהִלָּתִי / בַּאֲדֹנָי — the Arabic is 'my boast is in the Lord' (أَمَّا أَنَا فَفَخْرِي بِالرَّبِّ); Hebrew uses תְּהִלָּה, the word of Jer 9:23 ('in this let him glory'), which is the verse behind the line.
2:4 פְּנֵי אֵל — 'the face of God'; the Arabic has وَجْهَ الله, and the beatific vision is the point, so the anthropomorphic phrase is kept rather than softened to 'near God'.
3:4 אֶשְׂבַּע מִמַּרְאֵהוּ — 'I shall be satisfied with His appearance'; the psalm echo is Ps 17:15 (אֶשְׂבְּעָה בְהָקִיץ תְּמוּנָתֶךָ).
4:2 עַד־דּוֹר וָדוֹר — 'to generation and generation', for إِلَى مَدَى الدُّهُور; the fuller לְדֹרֹת עוֹלָם overshot the tune's fifth line.
